title: On the relationship between Benchmarking, Standards and Certification in Robotics and AI
base_benchmarks: NIST mobile robot mobility and navigation benchmarks
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspect of religion or faith. Its focus is on the relationship between benchmarking, standards, and certification in robotics and AI.
